CODE
 import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Year': [2002, 2002, 2002, 2007, 2007, 2007, 2012, 2012, 2012, 2013, 2013, 2013, 2017, 2017, 2017, 2022, 2022, 2022],
    'Sector': ['Agriculture', 'Domestic', 'Industry', 'Agriculture', 'Domestic', 'Industry', 'Agriculture', 'Domestic', 'Industry', 'Agriculture', 'Domestic', 'Industry', 'Agriculture', 'Domestic', 'Industry', 'Agriculture', 'Domestic', 'Industry'],
    'Withdrawal (%)': [3.1, 64.8, 25.2, 83.5, 10.5, 5.3, 84.7, 10.1, 4.9, 85.2, 10.0, 4.8, 86.1, 9.8, 4.4, 86.5, 9.5, 4.2]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.swarmplot(x='Withdrawal (%)', y='Sector', hue='Year', data=df, palette='viridis', size=10, dodge=True)
plt.title('Annual Freshwater Withdrawals by Sector in Slovenia (2002-2022)', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Percentage of Total Freshwater Withdrawal (%)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sector', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Year', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
SUMMARY
 This image is a swarm plot illustrating the annual freshwater withdrawals by sector in Slovenia over selected years between 2002 and 2022. The chart presents data points that show the percentage of total freshwater withdrawal for three sectors: Agriculture, Domestic, and Industry.

The horizontal axis represents the percentage of total freshwater withdrawal, ranging from 0% to 90%. The vertical axis categorizes the data into three sectors: Agriculture at the top, Domestic in the middle, and Industry at the bottom. Each data point is color-coded to represent a specific year, with a legend on the right side indicating the years 2002, 2007, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2022 in varying shades from dark purple to yellow-green.

For the Agriculture sector, the percentage of freshwater withdrawal starts at 3.1% in 2002 (dark purple) and increases significantly over the years, reaching 86.5% by 2022 (yellow-green). The Domestic sector shows a contrasting trend, beginning at 64.8% in 2002 and gradually decreasing to 9.5% in 2022. The Industry sector also shows a declining trend, starting from 25.2% in 2002 and reducing to 4.2% by 2022.

The data points are distinctly separated along the horizontal axis, avoiding overlap and clearly showing the distribution of freshwater withdrawals by sector for each year. The plot is well-labeled, ensuring clarity on the observed trends over the two-decade span.
